content.text: Learner engagement with written corrective feedback

uncitedSentences.sentence: Research on written corrective feedback (WCF) in second-language (L2) writing has moved from asking whether feedback works to asking how learners engage with it.

This review synthesises what the project library establishes about uptake, attention, and affective response across teacher-provided, peer-provided, and automated feedback, treating engagement as the mechanism that conditions whether feedback translates into revision.
